item.title: The Sahel insurgency: the situation
item.description:
Militant groups in Nigeria's Niger state carried out a reprisal attack that killed at least 30 civilians and later deployed more tactical teams, while separate assaults killed 11 soldiers in the southeast, 16 near the Malian border and 25 in another strike. Fulani communities suffered mass killings of at least 64 people, and a Saudi national was kidnapped by suspected Islamic State militants in Niger. Insurgents have begun using off-the-shelf drones, and rebels in Mali claim Ukrainian officers are training them on drone tactics. The Sahel jihadist insurgency caused 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
